title: Citation Validator
description:
A free, open citation validator. It checks each reference in a bibliography against public scholarly databases (CrossRef, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv) and reports whether the citation can be verified, without treating "I cannot verify this" as "this is fake." A deterministic pass resolves DOIs and compares the returned record—title, authors, and year—against the citation as written; an optional AI second pass reviews only what the deterministic pass could not settle.
